functions.name: GenerateTethers
functions.signature: GenerateTethers(Target, Points, Indices, Max Distances, Tether Ends, Use Geodesic Distance)
functions.docs:
Generate the tethers by following the triangle mesh network from the closest kinematic tether end to each dynamic point.
Inside array items can be processed concurrently, but the outside array must be iterated on sequentially.
